name: BabiloniaBTC
description: BabiloniaBTC is a community-driven Web3 ecosystem combining automated Spot trading
longDescription:
BabiloniaBTC is a community-driven Web3 ecosystem built around real utility, collaboration, and automated trading.

Our ecosystem combines the BAB utility token, competitive games, crypto and sports predictions, and an automated trading bot designed to take advantage of market price fluctuations.

Our main integration with Lighter allows users to automate their trading strategies while maintaining control of their funds in their own connected accounts.

Babilonia Trading Bot operates according to predefined trading parameters, automatically identifying entry and exit opportunities and providing users with real-time visibility into their trading activity, open positions, and performance.

By integrating Lighter, we aim to take advantage of its trading infrastructure and competitive fee structure to make automated trading more accessible and efficient for our community.

BabiloniaBTC is not just a trading bot. It is a growing ecosystem where developers, traders, and Web3 enthusiasts can contribute ideas, test new features, and participate in building the platform.

Our goal is to create a transparent, community-powered environment where technology and collaboration drive continuous development.

The money never sleeps.
